name: Micropulse Incorporated
old_description: Since 2003, Micropulse has focused exclusively on meeting the quality demands and regulatory requirements of an evolving orthopedic market.
about:
Micropulse Incorporated was established in 1988 by Brian Emerick in a 240-square-foot section of his family garage in Columbia City, Indiana. The company has operated from that same community since its founding, with Emerick remaining as CEO and founder.

Since 2003 Micropulse has concentrated exclusively on the orthopedic market, operating four product lines under one roof: orthopedic instruments, orthopedic implants, custom-made cases and trays, and sterile packaging. The facility spans approximately 100,000 square feet and employs around 288 people. Capabilities include CNC machining, broach grinding, assembly, and sterile packaging, allowing a single purchase order to deliver a fully machined, sterile-packed implant.

The company serves major, mid-tier, small, and start-up orthopedic device manufacturers. Customers include world-class orthopedic companies that rely on Micropulse for supply-chain responsiveness and regulatory compliance.

Micropulse emphasizes a culture of servant leadership, integrity, and continuous improvement. Its quality management system conforms to ISO 13485:2016 and 21 CFR Part 820, and the company highlights the advantage of consolidating all product lines in one location to simplify procurement and reduce lead times.
